$comment: PLACEHOLDER RECORDS — salary accounts and monthly payroll runs for Feelsafe Technology India Private Limited (brand "Interior bazzar", New Delhi, GSTIN 07AAFCF1234A1ZK, CIN U62090DL2024PTC434514). Replaced by GET /admin/finance/salary-accounts and GET /admin/finance/salary-runs. A salary account is Finance's record of what one person is paid; the PERSON is Team's — `memberId` joins `AdminUserRow.id` on the live Team endpoint, and this module never invents a member. `memberName` is a denormalised copy of the name as it stood when the record was written, kept for one reason: a slip issued in June must still name the person it paid even if Team renames them in September. Read the name for display from Team; read it from here on an issued slip. Salaries are always paid from ACC-HDFC-4021, the HDFC current account — every slip in this seed carries that accountId and no other. No slip carries a bankLineId: none of these debits is on an imported statement here, and an empty match would read as a made one. Integer paise everywhere; asOf 2026-08-25T09:00:00+05:30, so August is still running and nothing is dated after the 25th.
$comment_accounts: Seven accounts — a director, a sales head, three sales executives, a designer and an operations executive — one of which is closed. Vikram Chauhan (SAL-AC-0018) left on 30 Jun 2026 and reads active:false: he must render as an account with a history and no payable slip, which is a different thing from a deleted row. `monthlyGrossPaise` is exactly the sum of `earnings`, and the slip is built from these monthly components and nothing else. `ctcPaise` was here and is GONE (2026-08-31): it was presentational, nothing computed from it, and it needed two cautions on the record page saying it was not really cost to company — FN-OD-06 says employer PF and gratuity are not modelled, so the figure could only ever mislead. A number that has to be defended twice is a number worth deleting. Earnings follow the ordinary Indian split — Basic at 45% of gross, HRA at half of Basic, the remainder as Special allowance, with a conveyance or performance allowance where the contract has one. Deductions: provident fund is 12% of Basic restricted to the ₹15,000 statutory wage ceiling, so every account contributes ₹1,800 — the ceiling varies, not the salary; professional tax is Delhi's flat ₹200; TDS exists only on the three accounts that actually cross the threshold, and on the others the component is ABSENT rather than zero, because a zero TDS line is a claim that tax was computed.

events.note: Opened at incorporation. Director's remuneration, ₹2,50,000 a month, fixed by board resolution dated 12 Jan 2024. No UAN — a director drawing remuneration is outside EPF membership here; the ₹1,800 line is a voluntary contribution the board kept.

The performance allowance is FIXED and is not the incentive: it is committed pay, and it is counted in the fixed half of the payroll charts.

$comment_runs: PLACEHOLDER RECORDS — monthly payroll runs, newest first, covering 2025-01 to 2026-08. A run FREEZES its slips: each carries its own copy of the components as they stood, so a raise cannot rewrite a document already issued, and the two raises in this fixture (Aditya Rao from October 2025, Karan Sethi from August 2026) are visible only because of it. The history starts in JANUARY 2025 so calendar 2025 is a complete twelve months, which is the window the analytics tab reads — a year chart whose first quarter is empty teaches nothing about the company and everything about the fixture. 2024-12 AND EARLIER DELIBERATELY HAVE NO RUN: check-finance-ledger opens a run for a past month to test openSalaryRun and needs one with no run and 31 days in it. INCENTIVES APPEAR ON PAID SLIPS ONLY — an incentive is granted when somebody is paid (paySalary), not when the run is cut, so the open August run carries `incentives: []` rather than a figure. Sales earn one monthly against what they closed and about one month in eight pays nothing; Design bills on delivery so most months pay something; Operations draw an occasional service bonus; LEADERSHIP DRAWS NONE, which is modelled rather than missing — a director's remuneration is fixed by board resolution, and that contrast is what makes the department chart worth looking at. `incentivePaise` is Σ `incentives` and `grossPaise` INCLUDES it. Loss of pay pro-rates `earnings` and never the incentive — Priya Nair's January 2026 slip is the exhibit. Replaced by GET /admin/finance/salary-runs.

slips.heldReason: Campaign advance of Rs 40,000 drawn in July is still unreconciled against agency invoices. Released the moment the claim is filed or the advance is recovered — this holds AUGUST only, and every other month owed to him pays on time.

Meera Joshi, 2 days loss of pay against an approved-leave shortfall: 29 paid days of 31 — the month's real length, never a notional thirty. Every earning multiplied by 29/31 and truncated to the paise. DEDUCTIONS ARE NOT PRO-RATED: they are typed on the account as flat monthly amounts and this module does not derive which of them are proportional, so Provident fund stays Rs 1,800 and Professional tax stays Rs 200. Statutory PF is in truth 12% of basic and would fall with it; that is FN-OD-16, stated rather than quietly computed.
